payload.definition: A Choir Confessor's charge on its most wounded ally: a heal, a [Cleanse] of its debuffs, and a [Ward]. Kill it first, or [Interrupt] it.
Used from the ability bar on your turn, paying its mana or cooldown.
On one of the four tiles touching this one: up, down, left or right.
A Bulwark Shieldbearer's charge: every ally within 2 tiles of it gains [Ward]. [Interrupt] it, or pull the soldiers apart.
A Bulwark Siphoner's charge: it hits one hero, and an orb leaves the party's bank when it lands. Spend your orbs first, or [Interrupt] it.
AGI. Quick hands: better unarmed strikes and better odds when stealing.
Help for allies: heals, cures and boosts.
Area of effect: hits every target in a shape, not just one.
Can't move or act until something hits or moves it. A [Stun].
Winning slowly: damage over time and outlasting the foe.
A strike from behind for extra damage.
A wild animal monster: wolves, bats, the yeti. Beasts have no society, so they never make a [pincer] on their own, but a Monster Tamer can turn one [Tamed].
Its attacks miss far more often.
An Infernalist Bloodbinder's charge: it heals its most wounded ally and turns it [Empowered]. [Interrupt] it, or kill the binder first.
The Hellspawn's hunger: their blows land 50% harder on a hero below half HP. Heal the wounded, or keep them out of reach.
A brief afterimage: +15 [Evasion] for 2 turns.
Close-quarters fists and grapples.
A tough melee hitter that trades blows head-on.
Makes allies stronger with buffs.
A Herd Gorer's charge down a marked line to the board's edge: every hero still on the line is trampled. Step off it, or [Interrupt] it.
On fire: takes damage over time. Stacks up to three times.
Seconds a spell charges on the timeline before it goes off. Hitting the caster meanwhile can push the cast back or break it.
Removes debuffs.
Swings wide, hitting several foes at once.
Follow-up blows that hit hardest after an opener.
Bends the fight with statuses and the timeline more than raw damage.
The Tactician's order: a foe's timeline icon trades places with the foe whose turn is furthest off. The one about to act goes to the back; the straggler steps up.
An instant hit back at the attacker, at half power. Counterstrikes never chain.
A critical hit: extra damage. The chance grows with LCK.
Stopping or slowing several foes at once.
A hex that lingers on a foe and weakens it.
Weakens foes with debuffs.
Struck in melee by a foe standing next to you (a pincer, supporter or melee hit), not by a spell or a shot from range.
Keeping foes away, fighting from range.

When an attack misses or is slipped. Hit chance starts at 80%, rises with the attacker's SPD and LCK, and stays between 5% and 95%; the defender's [Evasion] takes its share off the top, and [Blinded] attackers miss more.
Steals health or power from a foe.
A Watch Vigilant's charge: every ally within 2 tiles of it gains [Regen]. [Interrupt] it, or cut the Vigilant down first.
Deals more damage with every pincer, skill and spell for a few turns.
Fights with gadgets: turrets, traps and devices placed on the board.
Healing paid for in the healer's own HP instead of mana: the Herald's gift. It never takes her last HP.
Points shaved off a foe's hit chance: AGI × 0.2 + LCK × 0.1 (at most 25), plus gear and [Blurred], capped at 40. A blow it slips is a [Dodge]. [Pincer] and [Supporter] blows can't be dodged.
A fair chance: about 35% (28 to 42%).
Dread that weakens a foe's will to fight.
A Herd Boss's charge: every ally within 2 tiles heals and rushes its next turn. [Interrupt] it, or kill the Boss first.
A frontline all-rounder: steady melee damage and staying power.
Wins from the sides and behind, where foes are open.
Moving well: repositioning to set up pincers and avoid harm.
Encased in ice: can't move or act, and its timeline icon stops until it thaws. A [Stun].
Devices and tricks used on the board.
A Harpy Shrieker's charge: a whirling gale that hits one hero and every hero beside it and drags each up to 2 tiles toward the harpy, out of formation. [Interrupt] it, or spread out.
A good chance: about 50% (43 to 62%).
Ends your turn early; the turn time you didn't use fills the mana bubble.
A protector that stands in front and takes hits for the party.
Slides a timeline icon forward so it acts sooner; the opposite of [Pushback].
Mends and cleanses; heals grow with WIS.
An Infernalist Pyromancer's charge: fire on one hero and the four tiles beside it, which [Burns] each one hit. Spread out, or [Interrupt] it.
INT. Raises spell damage.
Hitting a charging caster: the cast can be pushed back on the timeline or broken outright.
Puts a foe on the ground, costing it time.
LCK. Critical hits, accuracy, steals and the rare Clutch.
Heals the attacker a share of the damage its blow deals.
Likely: about 75% (63% and up).
Fills the party's mana meter; every 100 is one orb for spells.
Tears into foes up close with claws and fangs.
A foe left exposed by a status or a missed blow: the moment to strike.
Always on. A passive never takes a slot, mana or a turn.
Waiting for the right moment rather than rushing in.
Weapon damage: blades, fists, claws and arrows, as opposed to fire, ice and other magic.
A shot that passes through to hit the targets behind.
Two allies in one row or column with foes and nothing else between them: both strike every foe in the line. Heroes' main source of damage.
Takes Poison damage over time.
Leaps onto prey from a distance.
The big diamond at the timeline's left end: who acts next, and in how many seconds.
Takes less damage for a short while.
A Choir Psalmist's charge: every ally within 2 tiles of it turns [Empowered]. [Interrupt] it, or draw its allies away.
Shoves a foe's timeline icon back by seconds so it acts later: at most 2 s per action. Every hero [pincer] pushes each foe it hits back 1 s.
Goes off by itself when something happens (being hit, an ally falling): no slot, no mana, no turn.
A Hellspawn Emberheart's charge: the red river floods a hero's whole row, burning everyone in it. Leave the row, or [Interrupt] it.
Sends a share of the damage it just took back at the attacker.
Heals a little every second for a while.
A cry that rattles foes or rallies allies.
Decay that eats at foes over time.
An enemy with a society or that plans ahead. Only Sentient foes (and every hero) can make [pincer] attacks.
Attacks from range.
A Bulwark Siege Gunner's charge: one round down a marked line to the board's edge that hits every hero still on it. Step off the line, or [Interrupt] it.
Can't cast spells; skills and items still work.
A slight chance: about 10% (up to 15%).
Its timeline icon moves at half speed, so it acts later. On a hero it also costs the party [tempo].
A small chance: about 20% (16 to 27%).
The Lich's charge: magenta fire on one hero and every hero in the 3×3 around it, which [Burns] each one hit. Spread out, or [Interrupt] it.
SPD. How fast the unit's timeline icon fills, and a little accuracy.
STA. Staying power for long fights.
A hit on a charging caster that pushes its cast back on the timeline.
The Herd's loyalty: when any of their crew falls, every bull still standing charges, and its next turn comes sooner. Watch the bar, or [Pushback] them after.
STR. Raises the damage of pincers and physical skills.
Pincer damage first: grows with STR.
Anything that stops a unit acting, like [Frozen] or [Asleep]; its turn waits until the status ends.
An ally joined to a pincer attacker by an unbroken chain of allies. It adds its class's support action: a 50% strike, a heal, a buff.
With foes on two or more of the four tiles around it.

A wild monster fighting for you on its own: it keeps its own turn icon, attacks your foes, carries the [Pincer] keyword and grows its bond each turn. A full bond keeps it for the battle; standing at victory, it asks to join.
Every enemy that can reach the taunter must attack it, which keeps casters safe.
The party's pace. Each point of tempo slows every foe's icon; losing tempo brings their turns sooner.
An enemy charge that Slows every hero and costs the party [tempo]. Interrupt it or cleanse the Slow.
A Choir Cantor's charge: 3 Arcane to every hero, each with a [good] chance to be [Silenced]. Cast your spells before it lands, or [Interrupt] it.
Hidden hazards on tiles that hurt or hinder whoever steps there.

A [Wanderer]'s gauge (full at 6): +2 for each hero pincer they're part of, as an end or a flanker, and +1 each time a hero heals them. After the battle they join only if your companion says what they want to hear, and they trust you fully, or half, with a companion from their own faction.
Placed guns that fire on their own.
VIT. Raises max HP and softens physical blows.
A Void Sentinel's charge: a beam down a marked line to the board's edge that hits and [Silences] every hero still on it. Step off the line, or [Interrupt] it.

A hero you meet mid-battle who fights the monsters on their own: their own turn icon, never commanded, but they close [Pincer] attacks with you. Earn their [Trust]; standing at victory, a party member of your choice talks with them, and they may join.
A magic shield: the next blows land much softer.
Heated: the next Ice hit turns to Steam instead of freezing.
Soaked: Lightning hits it for x1.5, and Ice freezes it more easily.
WIS. Raises healing, resists spells and statuses, and holds a cast together when hit.
